description: BLIND held-out set 6, authored 2026-10-09 by an independent agent without access to search results, eval output, ranking code or tuning history; never to be used for tuning. Targets sampled read-only from the dev-org corpus with ORDER BY random(), filtered to bodies of 400+ characters and screened for credentials, tokens, IPs and hostnames. Stratification: note 16, memory 8, quoxplan (stream/plan/note kinds) 11, commit 6, transcript_session 5, other (finding, insight, governance_incidents, tasks_execution_wisdom) 4, total 50. Questions paraphrase rather than reuse title words and are answerable from the target note alone; acceptable lists are empty. Near-miss verification: each of the 15 topics was checked with SQL LIKE over notes.body for the org and returned 0 matches for these terms: 99.95, allkeys-lru, certificate number, twilio verify, ios app store, windows installer, hackerone, gdpr dpo, sla credit, annual discount, gitlab runner, kibana, lighthouse score, nutanix, clickhouse. Never to be used for tuning.
